svg.title: OpenAMRobot assurance: Open mobile manipulation. Engineered for safety.
svg.desc: OpenAMRobot assurance banner: the OpenAMRobot 2.0 mobile manipulator rendered from upstream's CAD and description packages: a white octagonal base with a red emergency stop, a lift column, two OpenArm arms hanging stowed and a head camera, over a dashed protective field on a perspective floor grid, beside the project name and the tagline Open mobile manipulation. Engineered for safety. Chips name the standards: ISO 12100, ISO 3691-4, ISO 13849-1, EN 60204-1, IEC 62443, Machinery Reg. (EU) 2023/1230.
